EV PA System Reference

Routing overview first. Use the equipment tabs only when you need to confirm the exact physical jack.

Green = Main / Sub Yellow = Monitors Dashed line = daisy chain
Important: There are two completely separate daisy chains: Subwoofer only and Monitor only. The right main speaker is not part of either chain; it runs directly from S16 #2 Out 8.

EV EKX-15P — Main Speakers

This is the exact rear-panel photo you supplied. No ports have been redrawn or altered.

S16 #2 Out 7 / Overall 15 → LEFT MAIN → INPUT 1
S16 #2 Out 8 / Overall 16 → RIGHT MAIN → INPUT 1

Where to connect

Use the upper combo jack labeled INPUT 1. On the real panel it is the first combo/XLR input beside the RCA section and above INPUT 2.

Do not use the XLR OUTPUT for the main-speaker feed. There is no main-speaker daisy chain in this setup.

EV ELX118P — Subwoofers

This is the exact rear-panel photo you supplied.

S16 #2 Out 6 / Overall 14 → LEFT SUB INPUT
LEFT SUB LINK OUTPUT → RIGHT SUB INPUT

Where to connect

INPUT: the lower jack, clearly labeled INPUT.
LINK OUTPUT: the upper XLR jack, clearly labeled LINK OUTPUT.

The right sub receives the daisy-chain at its INPUT. Nothing leaves the right sub.

The subwoofer chain is completely separate from the monitor chain.

EV ELX200 — Stage Monitors

This is the exact rear-panel photo you supplied.

S16 #2 Out 5 / Overall 13 → LEFT MONITOR INPUT 1
LEFT MONITOR OUTPUT → RIGHT MONITOR INPUT 1

Where to connect

INPUT 1: the first combo/XLR input on the upper row of the input panel.
OUTPUT: the male XLR output on the lower-left of that same control panel.

The right monitor receives the daisy-chain into INPUT 1. Nothing leaves the right monitor.

The monitor chain is completely separate from the subwoofer chain.
